auth.title: Entry to the base
auth.switchToRegister: I do not have an account

server.up: The Ariadne server at {url} is responding
server.down: The Ariadne server at {url} is not responding
server.downMeans: Without it you cannot enter the base and nothing will be saved.

error.credentials: This address and password do not match. Check the password or create an account.
error.server: The Ariadne server at {url} is not responding. Start it and try again.
error.emailTaken: An account already uses this address. Enter it with your password.
error.emailShape: That does not look like an email address. Check it.
error.passwordShort: The password needs at least 8 characters.

profile.title: How you work
profile.note: The agent receives this text at the start of every session. You can edit it now and later in settings.

q1.label: ROLE
q1.hint: Junior frontend developer, learning by building
q1.question: What do you do?

q3.label: WORK STYLE
q3.hint: Explain the decisions, not just the code. The simplest thing that works wins.
q3.question: How do you want to work?

q4.label: LANGUAGE
q4.hint: Talk in English, write code and comments in English
q4.question: Which language do we talk in?

profile.optionalAnswer: You can leave this empty, then this part stays out of the profile.
profile.previewEmpty: What you type shows up here. The agent receives this text at the start of every session.

project.title: First project

hint.name: ariadne-core
hint.limits: What this project deliberately does not do

error.name: A project needs a name.
error.repoTaken: You already have a project for this repository.

project.previewEmpty: The card grows as you fill it in. The agent reads it on every question about this project.

agent.title: Connect your agent
agent.label: YOUR AGENT
agent.what: This command adds Ariadne to your agent as a memory source. The token is embedded in it and never touches your repository.
agent.where: Paste it in a terminal and press Enter. Not using a terminal? Skip this step, the app works without an agent.
agent.tokenOnce: You see this token now and never again. A lost token is replaced with a new one in settings.
agent.tokenFailed: The token was not generated, so the command is not ready. Try again.

other.note: There is no ready-made command for this agent. Point it at the MCP server at {url} with an Authorization: Bearer header carrying the token below.

agent.copyUnavailable: Copying is unavailable. Select the command and copy it by hand.
agent.tokenWhat: This is your token. Give it to the agent as an Authorization: Bearer header.
agent.tokenWhere: Copy it now. Once you leave this screen you will not see it again.

home.nothing: Nothing has changed. The agent has not run a session in this project.
home.cut: Showing {shown} of {total, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}.
home.entries: {count, plural, =0 {no entries} one {# entry} other {# entries}}
home.stale: Data from {at}. The server is not responding, so it may be out of date.

empty.title: The base is empty
empty.note: The first entries arrive on their own once the agent finishes a session in a connected project. There is nothing for you to do.

assistant.title: Ask the assistant
assistant.empty: Ask about the project's past. The answer is built only from recorded entries, and you will see which ones underneath it.
assistant.nothingRecorded: Nothing has been recorded about this.

database.title: Talk to the base
database.note: Write what changed. Nothing is saved straight away: you get proposals to approve.
database.placeholder: We are reversing the decision to...

pending.title: To approve
pending.empty: Nothing is waiting. You can ignore this screen; nothing here blocks your work.

project.title: Project
project.repoFixed: Fixed: this is the address an agent recognises the project by.
project.graphEmpty: The graph appears once there are entries.
project.graphHint: Click a node to read its entry.
